title: Small-Balance Write-Off and Service-Recovery Courtesy (Hospital Account (Encounter Billing))
content:
## Small-balance write-off (in force)

When a patient-due Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account's remaining balance is greater than zero and at or below the small-balance write-off threshold after a payment or adjustment, the remainder is written off as a small-balance write-off and the account closes.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, a threshold of 4.99).* A remainder of 4.99 is written off and the account closes; a remainder of 5.00 stays on the account; a remainder of 0.00 needs no write-off.

## Yearly limit on courtesy adjustments (in force)

Only one courtesy adjustment is allowed per patient per calendar year across all accounts. The year is the calendar year, 1 January to 31 December, containing the posting date being decided, and the count covers service-recovery courtesy adjustments on every account of the patient.

## Sentences no longer in force

- The sentence that a representative may grant one service-recovery courtesy adjustment on an account when the patient reports a documented service failure (a billing error already corrected on the account, or a statement sent during an active billing hold), up to the courtesy maximum and never more than the current patient balance, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
- The sentence that a courtesy adjustment is never granted on an account in bad-debt status or on a balance under an active payment plan, and that it is not combined with a prompt-pay discount on the same account, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

The courtesy maximum of each patient class and the yearly count remain valid figures.

superseded_clauses: A representative may grant one SERVICE_RECOVERY_COURTESY adjustment on an account when the patient reports a documented service failure (a billing error already corrected on the account, or a statement sent during an active billing hold), up to service_recovery_courtesy_max_usd and never more than the current patient balance.
A courtesy adjustment is never granted on an account in bad_debt status or on a balance under an active payment plan, and it is not combined with a prompt-pay discount on the same account.
